## Definition
A system architecture where prior beliefs (priors) are decoupled from sensory input, leading to a relapse into constructed reality states under the Free Energy Principle. This concept provides a theoretical framework for designing TCC/iNEST systems that can model and mitigate maladaptive belief dynamics in neuromorphic inference networks.
